chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch.132: Li Huowang Buries the Dead & Sees a Dreadful Ghost
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang wakes with new, agonizingly sensitive skin and performs a grim penance by burying the dead of Dead Town. But his atonement is shattered when Danyangzi reappears with a vengeful Jiang Yingzi.
og_title: A Penance of Raw Skin – Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch.132
og_description: Danyangzi returns and he brought company. A chapter of painful atonement and crushing psychological horror.
twitter_title: Ch.132: He buried them all, but a ghost doesn't care about good deeds.
twitter_description: Pain. Atonement. A three-headed monster and a mutilated woman who won't stop staring. The Ao-Jing Sect says it's not their problem.
